label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
To: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: drivers christmas breakfast 2026

Hi Rhonda, its Gary from the bus garage again. Hard to believe its that time already. We want to do the christmas breakfast at your place like always if you'll have us. Saturday Dec 19 in the back room, 7am same as always. If the 19th is no good then the 12th would work too, just let me know which one you can do.

This year is kind of a big one. Earl is retiring after 31 years driving, his last day is Friday the 18th so the breakfast is the very next morning. We want to do something for him but he cant find out about it, so if he ever happens to call or come in please don't say nothing. His wife Carol is in on it, they'll both be there.

So here's what I got so far.

Count. Dwayne took the sign up sheet off the board and its 24 counting Earl and Carol. That's 19 drivers, 3 from the shop, plus the two of them. Is that too many for the back room or are we ok? I'll get you the final count by the Wednesday before like you want, so the 16th if we do the 19th.

Food. Same as last year would be great, the big pans of eggs, home fries and biscuits and gravy, and everybody orders there own meat. Last year it was $11 a head, which was fair. If its up a little this year that's fine, just let me know what it is so I can tell everybody.

Patsy cant do eggs anymore. Could you do her some oatmeal or pancakes or whatever you got? She's not picky she just cant have the eggs.

The door. Lonnie is on a walker now since his hip so he cant do the steps out front. Can he come in the side door, the one with no steps? And would it be unlocked at 7 or should somebody knock?

Earl. Here's where I need your advice. Carol says he'll be embarrassed by a big speech but he'd love it if the guys did something. I was going to get a sheet cake from Sugarcreek Bakery, they do a half sheet with writing and a little bus on top. Is it ok with you if we bring a cake in from outside? Or the other idea is honestly your cinnamon rolls are better than any cake and Earl loves them. Could you do a big tray of those for the table and we stick a candle in one for him? If you'd rather we do the rolls just tell me how much and how many you'd do for 24. Either way is fine with me, I'd just like to know which so I can order the cake in time if we go that way.

Checks. Separate checks again please, that worked good last year.

Coffee. I'm only asking because I know how it is with this bunch, they go through it like water lol. Last year the urn quit on you right around 8:15. Don't feel bad about that, stuff breaks, nobody held it against you. But since this one is Earls send off and people will probably hang around longer than usual, would you be able to have a backup pot or a second urn going just in case? If it would help any I could bring a big pot from the church, just let me know.

I think that's everything. Let me know on the date and the price and the cake or rolls and I'll get it all lined up on my end. Thanks again Rhonda, we always look forward to this one. Your place is about the only one that can handle us that early on a Saturday.

Thanks, Gary Hollins
